parameters.functionCode:
// Generate Tally XML
const invoice = $input.all()[0].json;

const tallyXML = `
<ENVELOPE>
  <HEADER>
    <TALLYREQUEST>Import Data</TALLYREQUEST>
  </HEADER>
  <BODY>
    <IMPORTDATA>
      <REQUESTDESC>
        <REPORTNAME>Vouchers</REPORTNAME>
      </REQUESTDESC>
      <REQUESTDATA>
        <TALLYMESSAGE>
          <VOUCHER>
            <DATE>${invoice.date}</DATE>
            <NARRATION>Tire Sale - ${invoice.invoiceNumber}</NARRATION>
            ${invoice.items.map(item => `
            <INVENTORYENTRIES.LIST>
              <STOCKITEMNAME>${item.brand} ${item.size}</STOCKITEMNAME>
              <QUANTITY>${item.qty}</QUANTITY>
              <RATE>${item.unitPrice.toFixed(2)}</RATE>
              <AMOUNT>${item.total.toFixed(2)}</AMOUNT>
              <HSNCODE>${item.hsnCode}</HSNCODE>
              <TAXCLASSIFICATIONNAME>GST</TAXCLASSIFICATIONNAME>
            </INVENTORYENTRIES.LIST>
            `).join('')}
            <ALLLEDGERENTRIES.LIST>
              <LEDGERNAME>Sales</LEDGERNAME>
              <ISDEEMEDPOSITIVE>No</ISDEEMEDPOSITIVE>
              <AMOUNT>${invoice.total.toFixed(2)}</AMOUNT>
            </ALLLEDGERENTRIES.LIST>
          </VOUCHER>
        </TALLYMESSAGE>
      </REQUESTDATA>
    </IMPORTDATA>
  </BODY>
</ENVELOPE>`;

return { tallyXML };
